rules_when_unqualified.backwards_step: the base is refused for scheduling over that range, because one continuous clock across the step is not established by the record
rules_when_unqualified.clock_unknown: a base that only names a clock is not evidence of a shared clock source
rules_when_unqualified.equal_adjacent_values: ties are shown as ties; they are not interpolated and a rate is not computed by dividing by zero
rules_when_unqualified.missing_or_non_numeric_time: the base is refused for scheduling; the frame stays visible in append order and no value is filled from another record
rules_when_unqualified.undecidable_or_truncated_scan: no whole-episode schedule is claimed: undecided content could hide an anchor, so the clean timing of the readable anchors cannot prove the rest of the Episode
